_law: THE TIERS A SEARCH HAS TO REACH BEFORE 'no such asset exists' IS A TRUE SENTENCE. R8 decides BUILD vs ACQUIRE; this file decides what ACQUIRE means, because the answer stopped being 'free only' on 2026-08-01 and the lane kept searching as if it had not.
_owner_order_2026_08_01: ฿0 + CC0/public-domain เท่านั้น ยกเลิกข้อนี้
_what_it_cost: D-074 (2026-08-16) declared a SOURCING GAP for the bed cloth from a survey of 68 cached folders. Every one of those folders came from a FREE tier (Poly Haven CC0 + 3D Warehouse). The three paid tiers below have never been attempted once, in this repo's whole history, while docs/DECISIONS-render-assets.md has carried their verified prices and licences since 2026-07-01 with the note 'Status: DEFERRED — founder will decide later'. Forty-six days later the lane converted 'we have not bought one' into 'one does not exist' and went back to hand-modelling — which is the class R8 forbids, reached through a gap that was never measured.
_the_rule: A gap is a statement about the WORLD. 'not-attempted' is a statement about US. A declaration that mixes them is refused by name in pipeline/scripts/sourcing_check.py, and the row becomes a PROCUREMENT ASK carrying a price — which is his call per purchase (R8), routed into the plan's owner channel and printed in the render path, never a blocking queue (R3).
_paid_permitted_because: R8 as amended 2026-08-01: 'any source whose licence permits commercial use of the RENDER ... CC-BY with attribution recorded, paid libraries'. The delivery law is unchanged and is not a sourcing question: a non-redistributable mesh never enters git, the client gets the assembled SCENE, and scale is ASSERTED on every ingest.

tiers.name: Poly Haven / CC0 pool
tiers.note: The only tier whose meshes may be committed. Vintage-heavy; modern-luxury furniture is its known hole (measured 2026-07-01).

tiers.name: 3D Warehouse
tiers.licence: Trimble General Model License — use yes, redistribute as a model no
tiers.note: The practitioner rung: his friend's main source. Gitignored cache (.gitignore:50). Style hit rate is low per query, so a search that returns nothing usable is a statement about the QUERY as often as about the tier. — MEASURED p2r46 (2026-08-17), and this tier's own sentence above turned out to be the finding: 68 cached models was the WHOLE shelf, of which TEN ever staged as bed cloth, and no query behind them was recorded anywhere. 12 fresh queries (Portuguese 'roupa de cama'/'colcha'/'edredom' beat every English term on this corpus) surfaced 8-384 MB bedding against the 1-3 MB covers this lane had been auditioning. Every query is now logged in qa/warehouse-search-log.json. THE TIER'S REAL LIMIT, measured rather than assumed: its dense meshes are SUB-METRE objects (pillow_set_a 63,492 tris on a 600 mm pillow = 10.3 mm; 799b6961 88,390 tris on 1089 mm parts = 9.55 mm), while every part big enough to be a 2 m bed cover carries 4k-22k tris and measures 20-45 mm. Fineness is a WORLD measurement, so a fine small mesh scaled up is a coarse mesh. A ~2 m cover at the 10.3 mm control needs ~75,408 triangles IN ONE SHEET; screen any candidate for it with mesh_density.py before spending a Blender import on it.
